metadata.case_name: LEUNG SHING AND ANOTHER v. CHEUNG PING KWAI AND OTHERS

plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: likely to be restricted in the labour market to jobs of a clerical nature

injuries.description: Amputation of leg below the knee (about mid calf) with subsequent revision operations to the stump
source: The Plaintiff was injured in a road accident. He suffered severe injuries to ore leg and as a result his leg was amputated below the knee somewhere about the mid calf.

the amputation stump has had to be operated on already three times, with the possibility that he may require a further operation: as his tibia grows this affects the skin covering the stump, causing great discomfort, and a further operation becomes necessary.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation of lower leg, unspecified

manifestations.description: great discomfort (caused by skin covering the stump as tibia grows)
will not be able to walk long distances and stand for long periods of time
likely to be restricted in the labour market to jobs of a clerical nature

treatments_received: the amputation stump has had to be operated on already three times
treatments_future: possible further operation on the amputation stump

losses.description: Loss of job options / loss of earning capacity; restriction to clerical jobs and limitations on jobs he can take because he will not be able to walk long distances or stand for long periods
